notes: Both directions are read from the source tables. Neither is derived from the other: one provision frequently replaces several, and inverting a one-to-many mapping invents a precision the Act does not have.
'ingredients_changed' comes from the table's own (Change) marker. Those pairs are the dangerous ones -- a reader who assumes equivalence gets the elements of the offence wrong.
status 'no_successor' means the provision was not carried forward. It is recorded rather than omitted, because 'this was not re-enacted' is an answer and silence is not.
